data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Integrate Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts.
Success rates are shown using Chart.js visualizations.

features.title: Display Real-Time Metrics with Chart.js
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Real-time data is displayed using line, bar, and area charts.
Charts update dynamically to reflect current data.
Graphs are interactive and provide detailed insights.

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight Artemis features such as cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Features are clearly presented with supporting charts.
Charts accurately represent feature metrics.
Information is easy to understand and visually engaging.

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Include actual data from recent Artemis runs to demonstrate effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics are presented accurately.
Data is up-to-date and relevant.
Metrics are integrated seamlessly into the presentation.

features.title: Implement Professional Design
features.description: Design the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is applied consistently across slides.
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional.
Overall design is visually appealing and cohesive.

features.title: Integrate Supervisor Across Stages
features.description: Visualize supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration.
Chart is interactive and provides detailed breakdowns.
Integration data is clearly communicated.

features.title: Demonstrate Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Use a radar chart to showcase TDD compliance and adherence to SOLID principles.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays code quality metrics.
TDD compliance and SOLID principles are clearly represented.
Chart is easy to interpret and visually appealing.

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls for manual progression.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate through slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js library is included and functional.
